title: KC Spaces Fund Facebook posts archival production
objective: Account for the complete surviving public Page-post population, develop mission-relevant sources and claims, preserve organizer credit and unresolved Page authorship, and publish no protected social data.
population_boundary: One hundred percent means every distinct record exposed by the authenticated 2020 Page filter after four stable terminal checks. It does not mean every post ever created, a Meta owner export, or deleted-post recovery.

evals.title: Stakeholder references remain distinct from engagement
Interaction and follower values remain bounded snapshots
Organizer credit, Page authorship, and Jamie role boundaries
Knowledge lifecycle and selective website projection

required_mutation_classes: outgoing stakeholder reference converted to incoming engagement
reaction total converted to unique people or impact
current follower display converted to historical reach
participant naming memory converted to confirmed claim
protected body, identity, contact, route, or local-path leakage
